title: Settlement
description: Post-match settlement for a single bet. Unsupported markets MUST be marked manual_review; MUST NOT be hard-calculated.

model_account.description: Model account that placed this bet.

odds.description: Odds at time of bet (from odds_snapshot). MUST NOT use post-match odds.

payout.description: Payout amount in GP. stake * odds on win, 0 on loss, stake on push, null on void/manual_review.

profit.description: Net profit in GP. payout - stake. Negative for losses.

roi.description: Return on investment. profit / stake. Null if stake is 0 or settlement is not definitive.

notes.description: Additional notes, e.g. why a bet was voided or sent to manual_review.

odds_snapshot_id.description: Reference to the odds snapshot used for settlement.

match_result_source.description: Source of the match result used for settlement.
